name: Anubis
subtitle: Shepherd of Shadows
description: Balance the scales as you defeat your foes and drain their Turn Meter and Divinity.
lore: Guide to the dead of Aaru and guardian of the underworld’s gates, Anubis has always been a grim deity, but he grew ever more distant in the years preceding the Shattering. Yet he seems, peculiarly, to have regained a new sense of purpose since the world was remade, though it is one that often keeps him traveling, away from his sacred duties.
divinity_generator: Gain [100] Divinity whenever an enemy is defeated. Gain [200] if they were defeated by Soul Guide.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Ignore RES +20%, Barrier Multiplier +30%, Heal Multiplier +30%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%
Awaken the ability: Weigh the Scales

skills.name: Soul Guide
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (6%HP+60%ATK)2 times. If the enemy is defeated, has 75% chance to place [mechanic:despair] for 1 turn on all enemies.
skills.awakening_bonus: If the enemy is defeated, also steal 20% Divinity from all enemies.

skills.name: Embalming Blast
skills.description: Attack all enemies (13%HP+85%ATK) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:corrupt] and [mechanic:init-down-ii] for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: If an enemy is defeated, Decrease the cooldown of this ability by 1 turn.

skills.name: Weigh the Scales
skills.description: When a hero is defeated, increase this hero’s turn meter by 20%.
skills.awakening_bonus: If the hero is an enemy, place [Banish] for 1 turn. If the hero is an ally, gain [200] Divinity.

skills.name: Tomb Watcher
skills.description: Attack all enemies (17%HP+100%ATK). If this hero’s HP is below 50%, heals this hero by 30% of the damage inflicted. If this Hero’s HP is above 50%, place [mechanic:barrier] for 30% of the damage inflicted.

imprint_passive: When a hero is defeated, Increase this hero’s turn meter by 10%.
